payload.title: Images on posts (#25)
payload.objective: Let a member add images to a post, per channel text, and publish them to Facebook and LinkedIn with the same approval and idempotency rules as text.
successCriteria: Images are uploaded in the editor and attached per channel within its capabilities
Stored as disk and path per workspace, never served across workspaces or to signed-out visitors
Uploads validated by content, metadata removed, limits configurable
Facebook and LinkedIn publish images idempotently and only after approval
Changing images after approval invalidates it
